short: @zurfur/ui: the component library and its gallery
is: @zurfur/ui — a private SvelteKit library of components, consumed by `web` as TypeScript source, with a component gallery (its routes) prerendered by adapter-static and served on loopback by `just gallery`.
conventions: Consumed as source, no package step: `exports` gives `types` and `svelte` the same entry, `src/lib/index.ts`; the version stays `0.0.0` and `web` depends on exactly that. Routes import the library only as `@zurfur/ui`; `$lib` is banned in this package, since it would resolve to the importer's `src/lib`.
Plain client-side SvelteKit, nothing server-side: the gallery is prerendered (adapter-static, `strict`), and files that run server code (`+server`, `.server.`, hooks) are refused by a check.

`eslint.config.js` partitions `src/` into file sets (checks, routes, gallery, motion, lazy, and the components' rules for every other file) and runs with `noInlineConfig`, so no inline comment switches a rule off; lint guards against accidental coupling, it is not a sandbox.
`just gallery` serves on 127.0.0.1 at `ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT` or 5190 (`vite.config.ts` alone decides host and port; a busy port is an error).
Installs only through the workspace's guarded trio (`just frontend-install`), never a bare `yarn install` here.
